svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.62k stars in total, about 1.09k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 502, aube 2029, fnox 2266, hk 1261, pitchfork 683, usage 1054, +6 more 828.
